reviews.t: and I burn easily. The color seems to self-adjust because I'm very ...
reviews.x: It's a bit heavy, but it works. It is a functional sunscreen and keeps me from getting burned, and I burn easily. The color seems to self-adjust because I'm very pale and it doesn't stand out. Won't replace real makeup but is a nice wash of color for a little evening out of the skin. I just feel like it doesn't wash off very easily in the shower, but that's also an advantage because you won't sweat or swim it off very easy either.

reviews.t: Disappointed

IMO, a good BB or CC cream will do you just as well plus has more coverage.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the tint subtle and natural-looking, providing light coverage that evens out skin tone without looking heavy.
Several reviewers praise it as an effective sunscreen that protects against sunburn and absorbs without feeling greasy.
Some reviewers are disappointed with the coverage, saying it is hardly tinted and still requires full face makeup.
A few reviewers note texture issues, describing it as heavy, not creamy smooth, or prone to peeling when layered over serums.
Some reviewers object to the ingredient octyl methoxycinnamate and wish zinc oxide were the only sunscreen ingredient.
